Each store is captured once per national run, so 30 Oct and 31 Oct medians come from different store sets (run started 7:22pm NZDT 30 Oct, captures to 8:25am NZDT 31 Oct). Day-on-day differences are not same-store changes.
Anchor butter 500g carries a special_type flag at all New World and Woolworths stores both days; median is the shelf price as captured.
1 Nov 2026 run: 31 Oct now a full capture day (up to about 102 Woolworths, 67 New World, 29 Pak'nSave stores). 1 Nov skipped: only 2 New World stores captured by 9am, too thin for a median.
